route_roles.deepset_context: per-particle predictor with mean set context
route_roles.local_interaction: direct predictor plus 8-wide inverse-distance neighbour summary
route_roles.physics_residual: normalized acceleration residual integrated into velocity

feature_contract.artifact_43_layout: base AABB summary only; no sidecar component block

particle_mlp.rollout_state_update: bounded output is next velocity; trapezoidal position update
particle_mlp.training_context_note: target subset; base features use full current context for COM

deepset_context.role: per-particle predictor with mean set context
deepset_context.rollout_state_update: bounded output is next velocity; trapezoidal position update
deepset_context.training_context_note: target subset; base features use full current context for COM

local_interaction.role: direct predictor plus 8-wide inverse-distance neighbour summary
local_interaction.rollout_state_update: bounded output is next velocity; trapezoidal position update
local_interaction.training_context_note: target subset plus full current context for COM and neighbour summary

physics_residual.role: normalized acceleration residual integrated into velocity
physics_residual.training_target: (next solver velocity - current solver velocity) / dt * dt^2 / dp
physics_residual.rollout_state_update: bounded output is normalized acceleration; semi-implicit velocity then trapezoidal position update
physics_residual.training_context_note: target subset; base features use full current context for COM

normalization.control: translation / length_scale; angular/derived velocity * time_scale / length_scale; angle sin/cos and availability bits
normalization.boundary_component: distance / length_scale; normal/type raw; wall velocity * time_scale / length_scale
normalization.time: elapsed time / time_scale and current dt / time_scale; independent of file endpoint
normalization.output: 8 * tanh(raw / 8), applied through train/validation/rollout prediction paths

state_semantics.data_read: full solver arrays are loaded for labels/reference metrics; only density/pressure/mass frame zero become model state features
state_semantics.teacher_forcing: train and one-step validation use solver current velocity and solver next velocity label
state_semantics.autonomous_rollout: starts from frame-zero solver position/velocity, then uses own predicted velocity and predicted position as current state
state_semantics.mass_state: initial mass is frozen and used for COM/identity metrics

training_state_semantics.sampling: per-epoch transition shuffle and per-frame random target particle choice using NumPy Generator(seed)
training_state_semantics.optimizer: AdamW, configured learning rate, weight_decay=1e-6, gradient norm clip=1.0
training_state_semantics.loss_and_selection: train MSE; one-step validation is reported; checkpoint selection uses mean validation autonomous rollout RMSE with min_delta/patience after min_epochs
training_state_semantics.checkpoint_semantics: saved model state after restoring best validation epoch; payload observed as state_dict plus route/seed/feature_width only
training_state_semantics.resume_state: not recoverable from observed checkpoints: no optimizer, scheduler, RNG, epoch history, best metric, contract ID, or config/data hash

findings.impact: The 43-wide results/checkpoints are historical base-contract artifacts and cannot establish behavior of the current linked-sidecar component input.
findings.required_change: Freeze one input-contract ID and rerun all four routes against the active 115/123-wide layout before making a current route comparison.

findings.impact: The six jobs support only paired diagnostics for LocalInteraction and PhysicsResidual; they do not support a four-route ranking.
findings.required_change: If a route comparison is needed, run ParticleMLP and DeepSets under the identical current contract, seed set, budget, and artifact-binding rules.

evidence.train_context: DeepSetContext.mean is over sampled target features passed by one_step_loss
evidence.rollout_context: rollout passes all current predicted particles to the same mean aggregator

findings.impact: DeepSets sees a sample-cardinality-dependent context during training/one-step validation and a full-set context during autonomous rollout.
findings.required_change: Either construct the DeepSets context from the same full current context in train/validation/rollout, or explicitly define and record sampled-set semantics as the task contract.

findings.impact: When the current 72-wide component block is enabled, slot 0/1/2 is not a stable semantic component across cases with the same IDs; the packed tensor omits component_id.
findings.required_change: Use a schema-defined canonical component-slot order (or an explicit slot/role encoding) before the next component-aware training run.

R3-G4 corrected development baseline execution manifest

findings.impact: Seeds, commands, and paths are recorded, but the result/checkpoint artifacts are not cryptographically bound to the exact trainer source, config, release manifest, data, or input-normalization contract. The six-run manifest has no config reference.
findings.required_change: Record source/config/data/contract hashes in both result and checkpoint metadata; add a config reference and digest to the six-job manifest as well.

findings.impact: A checkpoint can identify route, seed, and feature width, but it cannot resume the optimizer/RNG/early-stopping state or prove the state was selected under a particular config.
findings.required_change: Declare inference-only versus resumable checkpoints; for the latter save optimizer, scheduler, RNG, epoch, best metric, and contract/config IDs.

findings.impact: Train MSE and one-step RMSE are not cross-route comparable because PhysicsResidual predicts a normalized acceleration residual while the other routes predict next velocity.
findings.required_change: Keep target-specific losses separate and compare routes only on a common autonomous evaluation metric under one exact input/state contract.

findings.impact: The three seeds are initialized and recorded, but CUDA deterministic-algorithm policy and RNG snapshots are absent; exact rerun identity is therefore not closed.
findings.required_change: Add a deterministic policy (or explicitly record nondeterministic status) and capture Python/NumPy/Torch RNG state when reproducibility is required.

next_minimal_changes.change: Add one immutable input_contract_id containing active feature slices, normalization, target mode, rollout state, sidecar slot schema, and output-cap/clip semantics; bind trainer/config/release-data hashes in run/result/checkpoint records.
next_minimal_changes.why_minimal: One ID plus five hashes closes the current 43-versus-115 ambiguity without changing F6, tracer, or upstream inputs.

next_minimal_changes.change: Canonicalize boundary-component slots before packing the 72-wide block (schema role/order or stable ID encoding) and record the observed slot map.
next_minimal_changes.why_minimal: The current component tensor otherwise has target-relative values but no stable component identity.

next_minimal_changes.change: Make DeepSets train/validation/rollout consume the same declared current context cardinality, preferably full current context; retain target subsampling only for loss rows.
next_minimal_changes.why_minimal: This removes the only route-specific train-to-rollout context-cardinality mismatch identified statically.

next_minimal_changes.change: Record route target_mode (`next_velocity` versus `acceleration_residual`) and mark checkpoints inference-only or save optimizer/RNG/epoch/best-metric state for resume.
next_minimal_changes.why_minimal: It prevents target losses and inference snapshots from being mistaken for common training-state evidence.

next_minimal_changes.change: For the next comparison, rerun all four routes on the same current contract, seeds 17/29/43, budget, test cases, deterministic policy, and CPU-verifiable provenance; do not mix the 43-wide artifacts into the 115-wide result table.
next_minimal_changes.why_minimal: Only this closes route coverage and controls the remaining matrix confounds.
